description: Call this first when someone wants a collage, a carousel or a continuous swipe from photos. Pass photos (media ids from media_list) and get up to 5 finished layouts, best fit first: a carousel, a continuous collage that runs across slides, a framed photo or a grid. Nothing is saved. With render=true each option comes with a picture of its first slide. To make one a post, pass its doc to stills_create; then post_schedule when stills_get says ready. Pass faces (media id to a box) to keep a face off the edges and center on it.

faces.description: Where a face or subject sits in a photo, as fractions of it (media id to {x,y,w,h}). The photo is centered on it instead of the middle.

media_ids.description: Ready photos, in the order they should read

schema_version.description: The stills document version the app speaks (3 now; leave out for 1). An older app gets documents in its own version, or an UPDATE_REQUIRED refusal when the layout uses something only a newer version can hold.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: stills_options
title: Suggest photo layouts
